name: Complete client onboarding: Form to Monday.com, Google Drive & Email

parameters.content:
## Complete Client Onboarding Workflow

Automate your entire client onboarding process: collect information via form, create a Monday.com item, generate Google Drive folders, and send a welcome email—all in one workflow.

### How it works
1. Client/team submits the intake form
2. A new item is created in your Monday.com board
3. Google Drive folder structure is generated from your template
4. Monday.com item is updated with the folder link
5. Welcome email is sent to the client

### Setup steps
- [ ] Connect your Monday.com credentials
- [ ] Connect your Google Drive credentials
- [ ] Connect your Gmail credentials
- [ ] Deploy the Apps Script for folder duplication
- [ ] Update placeholder values in the workflow

### Customization
- Add more form fields (phone, address, budget)
- Add Slack notification after onboarding
- Create additional items in other Monday boards

## ⚠️ Configuration Required

**Monday.com:**
- `YOUR_BOARD_ID` — Your Monday board ID
- `YOUR_GROUP_ID` — Group where items are created
- Column IDs for: Status, Email, Folder Link

**Google Drive:**
- `DESTINATION_PARENT_FOLDER_ID`
- `YOUR_TEMPLATE_FOLDER_ID`
- `YOUR_APPS_SCRIPT_URL`

**Find Monday IDs:** Open board → URL shows board ID. Use Monday API or browser dev tools for group/column IDs.
